test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A thief steals a car at 2:00 p.m. and drives it at 70 km per hour. The theft is discovered at 3:00 p.m. and the owner sets off in another car at 105 km an hour. At what time owner will overtake the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the thief = 70 km/h

Speed of the owner = 105 km/h

Thief starts at 2:00 p.m.

Owner starts at 3:00 p.m.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Thief's head start time = 3:00 p.m. - 2:00 p.m. = 1 hour

Distance covered by the thief in 1 hour = 70 km/h × 1 h = 70 km

Relative speed of the owner compared to the thief = 105 km/h - 70 km/h = 35 km/h

Time taken by the owner to cover the distance of 70 km at a relative speed of 35 km/h:

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 70 km / 35 km/h

⇒ Time = 2 hours

Owner starts at 3:00 p.m., so the time when the owner overtakes the thief = 3:00 p.m. + 2 hours = 5:00 p.m.

**The owner will overtake the thief at 5:00 p.m.**
